scope: isolated corrected-observation research candidate; direct surface functions; not measured material
function: seven 3D hash-indexed triquintic continuous basis fields; log diffuse gain bounded [-2.5,2.5]; coefficients evaluated at rest-space surface hit
provenance: Fitted to the front photo and generated side observations with experimental source-landmark and colour-confidence masking; photo lighting and registration defects can remain. No photo is sampled by the field at runtime.

training.source: same face photo and generated sides with experimental feature confidence; photo light remains
training.split: random pixels from same captures; not independent

limitations: Not measured physical albedo, normals or scattering
Generated sides are not the subject's photographs
Landmarks and colour confidence are unverified
Same-capture random holdout is not independent; separate angles and people are required
Position and feature geometry are unchanged and not accepted

observedSupport.kind: dense triquintic interpolation of binary observed-cell vertices
observedSupport.source: all training views, no independent rear reference

supportProvenance: Copied v08 observed-support alpha after checking every new training hit; unobserved surfaces retain baseline material.
